Nina (CS): Quick heads-up — some onboarding imports showed incomplete records after indexing between 01:20-01:55 UTC. Engineering is on it. Need customer status copy, credit guidance, and enablement reschedule language.

Omar - CS Ops: Please segment by severity: blocker / partial / retryable. Ill prepare targeted templates.

Nina (CS): Uploaded buckets to #cs-ops-docs. Blockers: acct-lima, acct-orion. ~7 trials partially affected.

Chen (Support): Suggest: blockers get priority reindex + 2-week onboarding extension + 15% onboarding credit; partials get 1-week + 7% credit; trials 30-day extension. Offer 1:1 troubleshooting.

Diego (SRE): Root cause summary: transform job mis-handled nested nulls after a recent change; led to truncated docs. Patch and rollback applied at 02:00 UTC. Backfills running; current ETA ~3 hours for most queues. Posting progress logs to `reindex/backfill`.

Rhea (Product): For renewal-risk accounts, propose assigning a senior success lead and AM escalation. Billing pre-approves credits up to 15% under $5k MRR; AM signoff above. Temporary dedicated reindex pool possible with ops approval.

Nina (CS): Draft status for customers: "We're sorry  an internal transform issue caused some imported items to be incomplete after indexing. Engineering fixed the issue and we are reprocessing affected imports. We'll prioritize the most impacted accounts and follow up with an ETA. Your success lead will reach out to coordinate enablement and any credits."

Omar - CS Ops: I'll draft templates (blocker + partial + trial) and post in #cs-review in 10m. Please confirm credit wording and cc list (billing@redwood.com + AMs for >$5k MRR).

Chen (Support): I'll wire a 2-question pulse after send: 1) Did this block your go-live? 2) Would you like a troubleshooting session? Responses go to the renewal tracker.

Diego (SRE): Progress 02:30 UTC  40% processed, verification passing on completed batches. New ETA ~2-3 hours for current queue. Full postmortem EOD tomorrow.

Nina (CS): Thanks team. Once templates are signed, I'll send and schedule enablement slots for blockers. Will post final send time and recipient list here.
